name: Chao ngheu
summary: Rice porridge with sea clams, ginger, scallion, and rau răm, eaten hot at the start of the day.
origin: Hoi An. The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 4 September 2024 article, republishing Dân Việt, places the bowl at the beginning of the morning.
howToEat: Eat it hot, with a spoon.
seoTitle: Chao ngheu — clam porridge in Hoi An
seoDescription: Cháo nghêu is Hoi An’s morning clam porridge, with ginger, scallion, and rau răm.
